Curated by Skill Harbor — @full-stack-skills' tauri-app-sql skill: guidance for the Tauri v2 SQL plugin — selecting the database engine and connection string (SQLite, MySQL, PostgreSQL), configuring migrations in tauri.conf.json, enabling SQL plugin capabilities with minimal-permission scoped access, and validating queries and error handling in the app flow, with links to the official v2.tauri.app SQL docs.
